stages.report:
FALSIFIED. The belief that buying ETH/USDT at the Monday open and selling at the same day close beats random 1-day entries did not hold on the pre-registered test data.

**What was tested**
Buy ETH/USDT long at the open when dow() == 6 and exit at the close of that same trading day. Window 2017-08-17 to 2026-10-29. n_signals 480, n_trades 480, avg_bars_held 1.0, exposure_pct 14.28. Backtest mean_net_pct 0.12, median_net_pct 0.03, win_rate_pct 50.21, total_net_pct -1.54, max_drawdown_pct -70.77. Buy and hold total_pct 646.07 over the same window.

**Strongest evidence against**
Random-entry baseline failed. Rule mean 0.12% vs random-entry mean -0.04%; the rule beat 80% of 2000 random sets, one-sided p = 0.198. The pre-registered threshold is alpha 0.05. Fee and slippage sensitivity failed: at 0.25% per side the mean trade is -0.18%; the edge disappears at about 16 bps per side. Cross-asset test failed: better than random on only 3 of 9 other assets.

**What held up**
Sample size passed: 480 completed trades from 480 signals. Look-ahead guard passed: conditions use only past and current bars; every trade opens at the next bar's open. Multiple testing passed: first sealed belief about ETH/USDT; no correction needed. Time split passed: positive in both halves 0.19% n=240 then 0.05% n=240. Nearby parameters passed: 1 of 1 nearby variants point the same way median 0.06%.

**What would change the verdict**
A one-sided p-value < 0.050 for mean_net_return beating random entries with the same 1-day holding period, with at least 20 trades, would be required by the pre-registered criterion.

**Caveats**
The test is about the past window only. Versus just holding is info: rule compounded -1.5% while holding the asset over the same window returned 646.1% with 14% exposure. Falsify tests beliefs about the past. It is not investment advice and makes no prediction.
